name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 90% opacity. This keeps the ring crisp on high-DPI screens and mobile devices while maintaining strong visibility for keyboard users. The thicker ring also resists being clipped by rounded corners or container edges. Trade-off: the slightly larger ring may feel heavier in minimalist designs, but accessibility demands outweigh aesthetic subtlety.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring still risks fading into light backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 3px ring with 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity keeps crisp edges on mobile and high-DPI screens while meeting contrast on both light and dark surfaces. Test the ring against the lightest and darkest backgrounds in the system—if it passes WCAG 2.1 AA in both cases, it’s settled.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring still risks visual bulk on high-contrast light backgrounds where #005fcc’s 4.5:1 contrast is barely met—especially for users with low vision who rely on stronger cues. A 2.5px ring with a 1.5px inner #fff at 85% opacity would split the difference: sharper than 3px on mobile, softer than 2px on light surfaces, and still passes contrast checks. Test it against the lightest background (#ffffff) and darkest (#000000) to confirm.
